decisions.coupling: Added immune nuclei are contained in the authorized transition; quota, seam, compatibility, spatial-distribution and local-density checks pass, with sampling score 0.891.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap, border or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: The mask-only review cannot establish generated-H&E quality, clinical plausibility or outcome validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 01 as the single mask-condition handoff.
